capstones.name: Rage of Rallos Zek
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +50% melee damage, +30% accuracy. Roar fears non-dragon enemies (6 sec).
capstones.description: The God of War's rage — even dragons pause.

capstones.name: Valorous Rage
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +45% damage vs dragons/undead, +20% mitigation. Cannot be feared.
capstones.description: Valor that does not flinch — not even before dragons.

capstones.name: Dying Grasp
capstones.effect: Execute: if target below 25% HP, deal 4000 + (level × 20) unresistable damage. Heal for 50% of damage.
capstones.description: The dying grasp claims what is already lost.

mechanics.notes: Execute: only usable when target is below 25% HP. Unresistable damage; heals for 50% of damage dealt.

capstones.name: Torrent of Fists
capstones.effect: AoE: strike all enemies within 15 feet 3 times at +40% damage each.
capstones.description: A torrent of fists — the monk is everywhere at once.

capstones.name: Knifeplay Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, thrown attacks +50% damage, melee +25%, +15% double attack.
capstones.description: Knives dance — thrown or held, they all find flesh.

capstones.name: Desperation
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, damage scales with missing HP: +10% per 10% HP missing (max +90%). Requires <50% HP.
capstones.description: Desperation — the closer to death, the harder the axes fall.

capstones.name: Guardian of the Forest
capstones.effect: Self buff (5 min): +30% mitigation, +25% damage, track dragons at triple range.
capstones.description: The forest itself guards the ranger — even against dragons.

capstones.name: Roar of Thunder
capstones.effect: AoE roar: 1500 sonic damage to all enemies within 30 feet. Cripple (-25% damage) for 1 minute. -50% hate.
capstones.description: The thunder's roar — even dragons hear it.

mechanics.notes: 1500 sonic damage to damage author; -50% hate is threat/utility.

capstones.name: Song of Stone
capstones.effect: Group buff (3 min): 2000-point damage absorb (stone skin), +20% mitigation.
capstones.description: The bard sings the group into living stone.

capstones.name: Turn Undead
capstones.effect: Nuke undead/dragons: 3500 + (level × 18) holy damage. Undead below 20% HP are instantly destroyed.
capstones.description: The cleric turns the unnatural — even draconic abominations.

capstones.name: Spirits of Nature
capstones.effect: Summon 4 nature spirits for 90 seconds. Each deals damage and heals the group for 50% of damage dealt.
capstones.description: Nature's spirits fight and mend as one.

mechanics.description: Summons 4 nature spirits for 90 seconds. Each deals damage and heals the group for 50% of damage dealt.

capstones.name: Tigir's Insects
capstones.effect: AoE: all enemies within 30 feet take 40% slow + stacking disease DoT for 90 seconds.
capstones.description: Tigir's swarm descends — even dragon scales itch.

capstones.name: Beguiler's Synergy (Rank II)
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, whenever the enchanter casts mez/stun/charm, group gains +25% spell damage and +15% melee damage for 30 sec.
capstones.description: The beguiler's mastery deepens — control becomes carnage.

capstones.name: Virulent Talon
capstones.effect: Pet buff (5 min): pet attacks proc a 800-point poison strike, +30% pet damage.
capstones.description: The elemental's talons drip with virulent poison.

capstones.name: Embalmer's Carapace
capstones.effect: Lich form upgrade (10 min): +30% DoT damage, convert 15% of damage dealt to mana, +20% mitigation.
capstones.description: The embalmer's art perfected — death as armor.

capstones.name: Silent Casting
capstones.effect: For 60 seconds, spells generate 90% less hate. +20% spell damage.
capstones.description: The wizard casts in silence — destruction without witness.
